title: A profile of China's CXMT, whose $4.2B IPO goal would rank among the century's biggest chip debuts, as the memory chip maker faces US and South Korean curbs (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: A profile of China's CXMT, whose $4.2B IPO goal would rank among the century's biggest chip debuts, as the memory chip maker faces US and South Korean curbs — As AI demand drives prices up, CXMT overcomes Washington's curbs to vie with Micron and South Korean leaders
